item.tib: gnas brten gyi yan lag bdun pa
item.coloph: de ltar gnas brten yan lag bdun pa 'di/ tshe dbang thugs sras mkhan chen smon lam mtshan/ rab tu bskul mdzad yab sras gsum gyi sras/ o rgyan sangs rgyas gling pa'i yang srid mngon/ mi pham mgon po'i (pos)rang bzhin lhag par brtsams/ 'gal 'khrul srin na mkhas mchog gzigs bcos 'tshal/ dge ba ci mchis bstan pa'i rgyan mchog che/ rje btsun o rgyan mi pham mgon po yi/ mi nub brlabs chen 'gro don smin par shog/
